one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-10-14 to 2026-11-13. (1) FOMC Oct 27-28: the 2026-10-14 drop was a rates/AI shock (BLS Sept CPI +0.6% m/m, core +0.3%), so a hike would extend it and a hold would ease it (Polymarket hold 66.5% / +25bp 32.5%, ~$39.5M volume, context only). (2) Late-October hyperscaler Q3 results with first numeric 2027 capex guides; the standing AI-capex base case is up in 2027, mildly positive. (3) VST Q3 results and call Nov 6: management will update 2026 and 2027 guidance. 2026 is 'at or above' the midpoint and 2027 is trending to the $7.4B low end + ~$0.7B Cogentrix/Meta, which is largely known; Q3 consensus EBITDA is ~$2.1B (8 analysts, TIKR). The risk is a 2027 standalone below $7.4B on weaker ERCOT curves, or a delayed 2027 update if Cogentrix has not closed. (4) PJM's response to FERC's Oct 9 large-load order (no deadline found) and the December 2029/30 BRA (outside the window). Short-horizon regularities: the stock has had two ~6.4% sector-wide down days in a week (Oct 8 after a +20.5% run; Oct 14 on CPI), so mean-reversion and momentum roughly cancel. I keep a near-symmetric lognormal centred at +0.4% (median ~$152.8) with sd 15% (annual vol 50%/3.5 = 14.3%, plus a little for the call and FOMC). Unchanged from round 1: no supervisor finding bears on the next month.

comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: The discount should persist through the horizon. (1) Earnings are merchant: hedges fall from ~94% for 2027 to ~72% for 2028 (Q2 release) and management says ERCOT forwards are 'meaningfully lower' (transcript). (3) PJM has only extended the collar through 2029/30 and will set the 2030/31+ path after an end-2026 stakeholder evaluation (PJM ER26-1556 answer), so post-2030 capacity revenue is undecided. (4) Leverage: ~$23.7B net debt + preferred at the horizon after Cogentrix. Probability-weighted in-multiple long-dated risks net of nuclear upside are ~-$7.1/share (~0.3x). thesis_break_reason: At $116 the pro forma equity (116 x 340.6M shares incl. the 5.0M Cogentrix shares = $39.5B) plus pro forma net debt (~$22.96B = $19.16B + $2.3B cash + $1.5B assumed debt) and $2.48B preferred is ~$64.9B, ~8.0x the ~$8.1B 2027 pro forma adjusted EBITDA: ~0.9x below NRG (8.9x), the cheapest IPP, and ~1.8x below VST's own ~9.8x today. Round 1's $120 used non-pro-forma claims (it is really ~8.2x, too close to NRG to signal a break). Trading there without a market-wide crash would most likely mean: (a) the Nov 6 update puts 2027 standalone well below $7.4B or 2028 re-hedges show a structural ERCOT reset; (b) PJM moves to cap or administratively set 2030/31+ capacity prices. Status 2026-10-14: the ~$325/~$175 collar covers only the 2028/29 and 2029/30 BRAs; PJM will complete its stakeholder evaluation by end-2026 and then set the 2030/31+ path (PJM ER26-1556 answer, 2026-04-06); no extension has been filed; flag open, not tripped; (c) an AI-capex bust along the standing view's low case. A rates/AI sentiment day like 2026-10-14 should not take it there.
